'''Disguised Clone Troopers'''<ref name="Galaxy">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref> were groupings of undercover [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi apparel]] in an effort to entrap [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="Issue4">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 4|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> One such unit was [[Decoy Squad Five]].<ref name="Kit Reveal">{{EA|url=games/starwars/galaxy-of-heroes/news/kit-reveal-disguised-clone-trooper|text=Kit Reveal: Disguised Clone Trooper}}</ref>
